propositions: Cloud acli.update_issue() must never include status as a field in the jira workitem edit argv
status in update_issue() calls must be routed exclusively to transition_issue(), not mixed into field edit operations
a status-only update to update_issue() must not spawn a workitem edit subprocess and must return the key and new status
parity test for Cloud must mirror the DC test_dc_outbound_status_routing_5200 guard to prevent future refactors from incorrectly adding status to the edit payload
